sokkel-egui.note: JsonTree built before this spec, not yet compared with it.

summary: A JSON value as a tree that folds, in the code face: each list or object a line with a disclosure, its key and its opening bracket, open to a depth and folded below it, a folded one showing how many entries it holds; its entries one under the other behind a guide line; strings, numbers, booleans and null inked by type. An open list or object draws its first entries up to a limit and a step under them that draws as many more.

sokkel-ui: src/stories/fixtures/runPanel.tsx (a run's Outputs in a side panel)

anatomy.tree: The whole tree: text.xs in the code face, lines 20 tall, taking the width it is given.
anatomy.node: A list or object's line: a button holding the disclosure, its key and its opening bracket; folded, the count (words.items of a list, words.keys of an object) and the closing bracket after it.
anatomy.disclosure: The chevron at the node's start, 14 square: pointing right while folded, turned 90 degrees down while open.
anatomy.key: An entry's name in an object, followed by a colon and a space. A list's entries have none.
anatomy.bracket: The opening and closing brackets, { } for an object and [ ] for a list.
anatomy.count: Folded only: how many entries the node holds between its brackets, 4 in from each: the words.keys phrase for an object, the bare number for a list.
anatomy.entries: An open node's entries one under the other, 7 in from the node's start behind a 1px guide line, then 4 more.
anatomy.guide: The 1px line in border down the open node's entries, under its disclosure.
anatomy.leaf: A string, number, boolean or null entry: 16 in, where a node's key starts after its disclosure, its key then its value.
anatomy.string: A string value in its quotes, breaking anywhere when longer than the room.
anatomy.number: A number value in tabular figures.
anatomy.close: Under an open node's entries, 16 in from the node's start: its closing bracket.
anatomy.step: Under an open node's shown entries when more remain, 16 in: words.more with how many a press adds (the limit, or the rest when fewer), in the primary ink.

value.does: The JSON value to draw: an object, a list or a scalar.

open.does: How many levels deep lists and objects start open; deeper ones start folded.

limit.does: How many entries an open list or object draws before the step that draws as many more; at least 1.

guideInset.note: From the node's start to its guide line, under the disclosure's middle.

entriesInset.note: From the guide line to the entries.

leafInset.note: A leaf's start, the closing bracket's and the step's: as far in as a node's key after its disclosure.

rest.means: A node folded, a leaf, or the tree as it is drawn.

open.means: A list or object unfolded: the disclosure turned down, its entries, the step when more remain, and its closing bracket on a line of its own.
open.reached: a press on the node, Enter or Space on it, open

hover.means: The pointer over a node or the step.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a node or the step.

rest.note: In typeface-mono; the ink of what it stands on for what no piece inks.

focus.note: A ring on the node's own edge, no offset.

keyboard.does: Reaches each node and each step, in the order drawn.
Draws the next entries, up to the limit.

appText.value: The JSON value: its keys and values are drawn as they are.

cells.width: Fills its container. A node or a leaf is one row; a string longer than the room wraps at any character onto rows under it, at its start's column.
cells.density: Nothing changes: a node is one row at both levels, with no blank rows.

tree.note: One column at its start kept for a top node's focus bar.

node.note: The disclosure, one blank column, the key and ': ' in foreground, the opening bracket in muted-foreground; folded, the count in faint 1 column in from each bracket, then the closing bracket. On hover, the node's cells on hover. Keyboard focus is focus-ring-start and focus-ring-end in ring in the cell beside each end.

disclosure.note: chevron-right while folded, chevron-down while open, in muted-foreground: 2 columns with the blank after it (14 px).

entries.note: An open node's entries 2 columns in from its start: the guide in the first column, under the disclosure, a blank column, then each entry's row.

guide.note: The box glyphs' down in border, one per row of the entries.

leaf.note: 2 columns in, where a node's key starts: the key and ': ' in foreground, then the value in its type's ink: strings kind-green-ink in their quotes, numbers kind-blue-ink, booleans kind-violet-ink, null muted-foreground.

close.note: The closing bracket in muted-foreground, 2 columns in from the node's start.

step.note: words.more in primary-ink, 2 columns in from the entries' start; keyboard focus as a node's.

sokkel-ui: Each node is a native button with aria-expanded; the chevron turns with a transform transition.
Each node holds whether it is open, and how many entries it shows, in its own state: a new value keeps them by the entries' keys.
className lays the tree out in its container.
